edges.relationship: photoresist, stripper, etchant and wet chemicals for LCD/OLED panel fabs

contracts.signal: Half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): LG Display is Dongjin Semichem's third-largest customer - H1 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30) sales KRW 35,514M = 5.26% of consolidated continuing revenue, supplied as display electronic materials under a basic supply agreement via the local-export channel (LG Display order -> Dongjin delivery -> purchase confirmation -> payment). LG Display also provides Dongjin a KRW 83M interest-free 'win-win cooperation fund' loan maturing 07-31-2026 (backed by a KRW 1,000M Seoul Guarantee Insurance guarantee).

edges.relationship: display chemicals (stripper, etchant, wet chemicals) for Chinese Gen-8/Gen-10 panel fabs

contracts.signal: Half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): BOE is cited as a Chinese display maker whose new Gen-10-class fabs and rising utilisation are expanding demand for Dongjin's display materials; Beijing Dongjin began supplying BOE's Gen-8 line (BOE-DT) in 04-2011. The China panel-chemicals subsidiaries are now discontinued operations (H1 2026 revenue KRW 184,884M) following the 70% SPV sale; no BOE-specific figure is disclosed.

edges.relationship: Japanese electronic-materials supply (pre-acquisition related-party purchases; 100% subsidiary since 05-27-2026)

contracts.signal: Half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): Tokyo Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. (Tokyo, est. 03-15-1994) supplied Dongjin Semichem KRW 2,090M of materials plus KRW 44M other expenses in H1 2026 up to the acquisition date (H1 2025: KRW 1,636M purchases); on 05-27-2026 Dongjin Japan Co., Ltd. (set up 05-22-2026 with JPY 180M) bought 200 shares and then 400 new shares for 100% ownership (KRW 1,617M), moving it from 'other related party' to consolidated subsidiary - later intercompany trade is eliminated.
